text:
tess: heads up - Cobalt Analytics sent invoice CA-9901 for May but AP didn't route. PDF shows vendor entity 'Cobalt LLC (US)' while our PO 60198 is under 'Cobalt Analytics Inc (UK)'. file: https://files.redwood.example/cobalt-may.pdf

mike: can you paste the invoice total and vendor id? i'll pull the PO.

tess: total $12,750. Vendor ID 99301. invoice has no PO field filled. Line items: model evals $9,500, data transfer $3,250.

frank: ap-bot flagged entity mismatch + missing PO. this will block auto-approve.

ap-bot: automated message: invoice CA-9901 status: HOLD. reasons: missing PO reference; legal entity mismatch. ticket: AP-8132.

mike: PO 60198 exists but under the UK entity and closed for renewals. looks like vendor used a different billing entity. procurement should confirm which entity to pay.

tess: vendor contact (alisha) says they recently spun up a US billing entity and sent invoice from that. she confirmed work is same engagement.

frank: two paths: 1) vendor reissues invoice under PO 60198 (UK) and correct entity; 2) we create a one-off US-side PO and route for approvals; 3) accounting processes a payment with vendor-side memo and we reconcile later.

ap-bot: note: policy requires PO for recurring services >$5k.

mike: since this is recurring retainer, i'm ok with creating a manual US PO to avoid service disruption. please set po_type: manual-entity-fix and add note referencing original PO 60198. route to me + alisha (procurement) for approval.

tess: creating manual PO now. proc portal snippet:
```
vendor_id: 99301
invoice: CA-9901
amount: 12750
po_type: manual-entity-fix
po_ref: MAN-2423456789
gl: 6200-CONTRACT-SERV
cost_center: DATA-ML
notes: temp PO to clear invoice; reconcile to PO 60198 after vendor confirmation
```

tess: created MAN-2423456789 and attached invoice. routed to mike -> frank. :white_check_mark:

frank: small question: data transfer line might be billable to infra vs data team. want to split lines or bill entire to DATA-ML and reclass later?

mike: bill full amount to DATA-ML now; we'll run a journal split if needed after reconciliations.

frank: approving MAN-2423456789. approving to clear hold. :thumbsup:

ap-bot: automated message: PO MAN-2423456789 approved by frank at 2423456890. invoice CA-9901 moved to MATCHED. ticket AP-8132 closed.

tess: emailing vendor to confirm payment and ask them to reissue future invoices referencing PO 60198 or set their billing entity to the UK company.

procurement-bot: reminder scheduled: review vendor entity mapping for vendor_id 99301 in 7 days. assigned to alisha.

alisha: thanks. i'll update vendor master record to prefer the UK entity for contractual work and add a note to the vendor profile about billing entity changes.

mike: follow-up: procurement to add pre-check to flag invoices where vendor entity != PO entity and notify vendor contact automatically. filed as PR-112 for procurement backlog.

tess: great, thanks everyone. avoided a service disruption. :relieved:
